title: cvpw handoff.report.json
description: The MEASUREMENT of the handoffs declared in handoff.json. Derived, written only by `cvpw handoff`, carries a run record, and is never an input to a stage. Keeping it separate is what lets handoff.json stay reproducible (docs/SPEC.md A6).

grain.description: Must be `off`. Grain makes two frames at different times differ across the whole screen, so a seam compared with grain on would fail whatever the film did.

t.description: Resolved seconds of the boundary instant.

diffAB.description: Mean absolute difference between A's last frame and B's first frame. Null when the seam could not be rendered, which is a failure, not a pass.

diffARef.description: A against the contract's reference implementation — measures how far the outgoing side drifted.

diffBRef.description: B against the reference — measures how far the incoming side drifted. Comparing these two localises which side is wrong.

grade.description: The bands are defined in docs/QA.md (`handoff.pixel`), not here: a threshold must have exactly one home.

strip.description: Project-relative path of the A|REF|B comparison image, so a reviewer can look instead of trusting the number.
